body:
**Validation-only review — COMMENT, not an approval to merge.**

The four-line `tools/ci/admission-live-probe.c` change is an appropriately isolated code-path trigger: it does not alter compiler inputs. The hosted `changes` job passed on [run 40498518163](https://github.com/buster14a/buster/actions/runs/40498518163), and the native required `Build and execute on Ryzen 7 9700X` job (122170055727) was still queued when checked. The measurement-storage policy job also passed. This is a useful **pre-cutover baseline probe**, not yet evidence that the new admission path is correct or faster.

**Items to verify/record before claiming live acceptance for #546–#548:**

1. **Revision-bound approval:** the existing `/ci approve` comment was created at **2026-10-27 11:45:44 UTC**, before #557 merged at **11:47:19 UTC**. Under `docs/ci-9700x-admission.md`, a conversation-comment approval needs the controller to have *already observed* the current head. Do not assume this comment establishes P1 approval; after head observation, edit/repost it, or provide a trusted APPROVED review explicitly attached to head `375361b435cb1e99c9a1afe3a214c02843d3bd71`. Record the review/approval timestamp and the resulting priority receipt.
2. **Baseline and exact identity:** capture the native request/physical job's created, started and completed timestamps, queue/host-lock wait, and the precise head/base/merge identities. The physical job was still queued at review time, so there is **no measured runtime or approval-to-green result yet**. Because #557 landed after this probe opened, be especially careful not to count a qualification of an earlier base/merge as current-head/current-base acceptance.
3. **Controller acceptance remains untested here:** with activation and the root-owned host gate/capacity attestation in place, separately verify the authoritative required Check Run **and same-name commit status on the PR head**, the leased reviewed-main executor's run/attempt and immutable merge SHA, priority promotion/hold/resume/retry, conflict/cancel/resolve, no stale/skipped green, and main/daily recovery. Preserve Actions metadata and versioned receipts in `buster-performance`. A passing hosted selector plus a queued legacy job cannot establish those properties.
4. **Docs-only case:** adding documentation changes while `tools/ci/admission-live-probe.c` remains in the **overall PR diff** is *not* a docs-only test. Remove the code-path probe from the net diff for that phase, or use a separate docs-only PR.

**Disposition:** no code-level issue with the probe itself. Keep this PR draft/validation-only and **do not merge**, as its description requests. Do not close #546–#548's live-acceptance criteria before the measured and attributed campaign completes.
